prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production animation sprite atlas for the Unfold desktop pet app.
Create ONE precise sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows = 12 equally sized cells, canvas 1536x1152, each cell 384x384. No visible grid, no labels, no text. Every cell contains exactly one complete drawing of the SAME cat, transparent RGBA background, NO shadow, NO ground, no props or effects. All cats fully contained within their own cell, generous transparent 35px minimum padding, feet baseline y=330 inside each cell, consistent scale, camera, line weight and anatomy. Cat drawn about 245px tall at neutral, big expressive round head and small compact body, tidy dark charcoal outlines, cream highlights, gentle soft cel shading, clean professional cute 2D sticker illustration, readable at 192px desktop size. This must be original character art. Maintain identical markings, eye color and proportions across all twelve cells. No photographic texture. No pixel art. No color key or fake checkerboard. Export actual transparency.
READ LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM:
ROW 1 IDLE: (1) sitting neutral facing viewer very slight three-quarter left, both paws on ground, eyes open; (2) same seated cat gentle inhale, tail curves slightly outward, eyes open; (3) same seated cat eyes CLOSED blinking, tail halfway back; (4) same seated cat eyes OPEN again, gentle exhale, tail relaxed.
ROW 2 STRETCH: (1) seated neutral EXACT MATCH to row1 col1; (2) leans forward and extends BOTH forelegs diagonally screen-left, rear begins to rise, full body clearly visible; (3) deep unmistakable CAT PLAY BOW with BOTH front paws far forward screen-left, head lowered but face visible, hips high screen-right, tail curved upward; (4) same deep forward stretch extended slightly more, eyes happily closed. Keep head and body same actual scale as idle; pose shape naturally changes. Never turn away from viewer.
ROW 3 CLICK REACTION: (1) seated neutral EXACT MATCH to row1 col1; (2) seated, tilts HEAD slightly to screen-right, looks curious, both paws grounded; (3) seated, lifts its screen-right front paw to chest level, visible pink paw pads; (4) seated, raises same paw to cheek height in a friendly wave, eyes delighted, other paw grounded, same orientation.
Do NOT merely translate the whole animal between frames: articulate the eyelids, tail, head, and limbs as specified. All rows must be filled with all 4 cat poses.
SUBJECT: MISO, a warm orange domestic shorthair / ginger tabby kitten. Round broad face, pleasantly chubby pear-shaped body, short legs, rounded triangular ears. Golden orange coat, darker burnt-orange THREE forehead stripes and ringed plush tail, cream muzzle/bib/toe tips, dark brown oval eyes with small highlights, coral pink nose and inner ears. Friendly cozy personality. Absolutely no gray patches.
